Player action: Place a Production, Logistics or utility node
Trigger / reason: Only after successful placement; one cue for a pasted layout.

Player action: Finish moving nodes or placing a copied layout
Trigger / reason: At committed drop; remain silent while dragging or previewing.

Player action: Connect or replace a cable
Trigger / reason: After a valid route is committed, including multi-connection batches.

Player action: Disconnect a cable
Trigger / reason: After removal; do not also play when deleting its node.

Player action: Delete nodes
Trigger / reason: After confirmation and actual deletion, once for the selection.

Player action: Choose a recipe, Filter item or node configuration
Trigger / reason: Only when the selected value actually changes; no sound for opening the picker.

Player action: Queue research or enable the bot Upgrade
Trigger / reason: After acceptance; same cue for single-click action and double-click shortcut.

Player action: Pause / resume research
Harmony / phrase: D minor, falling wide / C major over E, rising
Trigger / reason: After the control changes the processing state; preserve separate visual state.

Player action: Pause / resume the game
Harmony / phrase: D minor, falling wide / C major over E, rising
Trigger / reason: After state changes; remain audible when entering pause.

Player action: Complete ordinary research / earn a Map Point
Harmony / phrase: C major → rising run → sustained F major
Trigger / reason: Once per new completion, including offscreen labs; never on save load.

Player action: Complete a character upgrade
Harmony / phrase: B-flat major 7 → A minor 7 → descending run → D minor 7
Trigger / reason: Replaces ordinary research completion for this event; Final upgrade is not victory.

Player action: Activate a frontier Map Node
Trigger / reason: After a Map Point is spent and access opens; activation and visiting stay separate.

Player action: Travel through the Node Map or a Road
Trigger / reason: Once after the active map changes, independent of Road shipment direction.
Repetition limit: 250 ms; no sound for current map

Player action: Attempt an unavailable placement, route or action
Trigger / reason: On an explicit failed attempt with a visible reason; no pointer-hover rejection.

Player action: Select a node or project / open a panel
Harmony / phrase: Single F-major chord / B-flat major, two-note rise
Trigger / reason: Useful only at very low level; try disabled by default because these actions repeat.
Repetition limit: 80 ms; selection or panel cue, never both

Player action: Toggle a node or change Road flow
Trigger / reason: After successful state change; reuse configuration feedback.

Player action: Create or disband a control group
Trigger / reason: After the group change commits; not while editing a name.

Player action: Undo / redo a factory change
Harmony / phrase: F major, two-note fall / Open A minor 7 over E
Trigger / reason: After a successful undo/redo; suppress the original action cue.

Player action: Manually save a slot
Trigger / reason: Only after browser storage confirms success; exporting merely requests a download.

Player action: Discover an important feature on first visit
Harmony / phrase: C major → rising run → sustained F major
Trigger / reason: Play once for the visit summary, rather than once per resource or discovery card.
Repetition limit: One grouped notice per visit; travel yields

Player action: New depletion or autosave-failure notice
Trigger / reason: Once when a distinct warning first appears; persistent text remains authoritative.
Repetition limit: 3 s shared cooldown; no repeating alarm

Player action: Complete the separate victory project
Harmony / phrase: F → B-flat → C7 → sustained F, with connecting runs
Trigger / reason: Once for the newly earned victory, replacing other completion cues.
Repetition limit: Never on load, reopen or continued play

Player action: Hover, pan, zoom, drag, type or close a panel
Trigger / reason: Keep navigation and continuous manipulation quiet.

Player action: Produce an item, deliver a packet or refill a camp reserve
Trigger / reason: Factory scale must not turn routine throughput into a wall of clicks.

Player action: Autosave succeeds / restore a saved factory
Trigger / reason: Background persistence and historical completions do not need applause.

Player action: Wait for inputs, output space or camp suppression
Trigger / reason: Do not repeat warning sounds for ordinary machine waiting states.
